headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 13, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Milwaukee Brewers, winning 14-5 behind a strong performance from their offense. Henry Davis led the Pirates' charge with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. The Kansas City Royals suffered an 8-2 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, while the New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals. The Chicago Cubs also secured a win, taking down the Cincinnati Reds 8-4.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Zac Gallen has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation, effective retroactive to July 9, 2026. Chris Martin has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder impingement, while Nick Lodolo has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a blister on his left index finger. Other players, including Mike Yastrzemski and Anthony Banda, have also been placed on the injured list.

There have been several trades and roster moves in the past day. Braden Shewmake has been traded to the Milwaukee Brewers, while the Chicago White Sox traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Toronto Blue Jays traded RHP Tommy Nance to the Minnesota Twins for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Pirates Rout Brewers 14-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Milwaukee Brewers, winning 14-5 behind a strong performance from their offense. Henry Davis led the Pirates' charge with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals suffered an 8-2 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, marking a tough outing for the team. Leody Taveras led the Royals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Curtis Mead leading the offense with a home run and one RBI. Ryan Yarbrough earned the win, while Paul Blackburn secured the save.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Reds 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-4 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Matthew Boyd earning the win. Alex Bregman led the Cubs' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 4 runs.

top_news.title: **Gallen Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks right-hander Zac Gallen has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation, effective retroactive to July 9, 2026.

top_news.title: **Shewmake Joins Brewers Roster**
top_news.summary: Braden Shewmake has been traded to the Milwaukee Brewers. The trade was announced on July 12, 2026.
